summary: TRANSCRIPT API KEY problem: limit-exceeded. 26/26 attempted; 2 Wowhead M+ letters moved, 0 published tier moves. WCL rdps broken, 3 raw keys landed. Bloodmallet MID2 held back.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 181-329 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> (first <td> = tier, tier-list-entry FIRST img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster). 80/80 assignments (raid 27/7/6, M+ 27/7/6), 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. THE M+ BLOCKAGE IS GONE and this run confirms it rather than re-reporting it: the live scale now carries all seven bands (S+ 100 ... C 30, widened by the owner on 2026-08-14), the M+ pages' bands are S+/S/A+/A/B+/B/C plus one literal TBD (Subtlety Rogue, stored as an explicit null), and all 40 stored M+ letters already reproduce the live pages exactly - 0 of 40 would move. The letters are still byte-identical to the icyveins-ptr list 40/40, which is a fact about Icy Veins publishing one Season-2 ranking twice, not a parse artifact. Era: all six pages read Season 2 in body - the raid-healer page again keeps a "Patch 12.0.7" title over a body whose changelog reads "13 Aug. 2026: Further updated for Midnight Season 2 launch", so body over title per the blue-tracker precedent - seasonVerified stays s2 on all six and the source keeps feeding the consensus through the frozen lane. published re-read per page, never carried forward: raid DPS/Tank 2026-08-08, raid healer 2026-08-13, M+ x3 2026-08-08, agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence. Snapshots already stood at 2026-08-15 from the earlier runs of this same UTC day, so there was no date to advance; the claim rests on the live re-read reproducing all 80 letters.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 188-324 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as this source requires: every title reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)" and the bodies head their rankings "Tier List for Season 2 of Mythic+ in Midnight". 40/40 specs read (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), ZERO tier moves - no rebuild since 2026-08-09, consistent with the Sunday 14:00 CEST cadence. Subtlety Rogue is still the literal upstream TBD and stays an explicit null, never omitted and never guessed (39 rated rows against a floor of 24). published RE-READ from each page rather than carried forward: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-09 on all three, agreeing 3/3 with published-evidence (the in-body "Last UPDATED" line still says 08-02; dateModified wins per refresh-tiers precedence). Third run of this UTC day, so the snapshot was already at today's date and could not advance.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 152-155 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched by roster match - the rejected alts are the 8 Season-2 dungeon names and the Method logo, rejected by ROSTER MATCH and never by position - and ZERO tier moves. Self-dates unchanged: raid "Last Updated 10th August 2026", M+ "Last Updated 13th August 2026"; the raid body names The Venomous Abyss three times and neither page mentions Season 1 at all. seasonVerified stays s2, so Method remains season-AHEAD: out of the live consensus in its own right and into the next-patch forecast, with its final s1 letters already in data/season-final.json keeping the consensus composition at 4. Snapshot already 2026-08-15 from an earlier run of this UTC day.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the full browser header set, HTTP 200 (a UA-only fetch is Cloudflare-403 on /guide/*; r.jina.ai is dead on this path and was not tried). Tiers parsed by unescaping \/ across the whole document FIRST and then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list], one block per page, with tolerant whitespace on each [tier-label]. 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and TWO real M+ DPS moves: Assassination Rogue B -> A and Shadow Priest C -> B. Both are upstream, not parse drift - the M+ DPS page re-dated itself to JSON-LD dateModified 2026-08-15T10:38:56-05:00 (was 2026-08-13), and its stored published was updated to 2026-08-15 to match, agreeing with published-evidence. The other five self-dates are unchanged and agree 5/5 with the evidence file: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid tank 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-08, M+ healer 2026-08-09, M+ tank 2026-08-11. All six titles read "Midnight Season 2", so seasonVerified stays s2 (season-AHEAD: consensus via the frozen lane, letters into the next-patch forecast) - which is why the two moves changed 0 published consensus letters and, measured against git show HEAD:dist/index.html, 0 projection letters as well.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists[], metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+, never the default popularity grouping; every entry resolved from its icon "Class-Spec" token, never the display name, since Archon writes "BeastMastery Hunter" / "Havoc DemonHunter"). 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, ZERO tier moves. Archon HAS re-cut: lastUpdated moved to 2026-08-15T12:00:00Z on all six pages (was 2026-08-14T12:00:00Z), and page totalParses moved with it (raid DPS 3992 -> 4277, healer 1041 -> 1120, tank 560 -> 600) - yet every per-spec parse count and every numeric value is byte-identical to the stored 08-14 cut, which is why the four numeric requirements below are partial while this one is not: the letters were genuinely re-read and reproduced, the numbers have nothing new to ingest. Era: the pages still describe Season 1 - the encounterOptions are the nine S1 bosses (Imperator ... Midnight Falls), the M+ selector holds the eight S1 dungeons, and the zone label is still "VS / DR / MQD" even though the page description now says "in 12.1" - so seasonVerified stays s1 and Archon remains the ONLY source feeding the live consensus in its own right.

Full re-fetch of 9 Season-1 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, 51/51 HTTP 200 with __NEXT_DATA__ present, 0 unmatched icons. 618 tier rows parsed and ZERO of them differ from stored. Six role cuts publish an EMPTY tier list upstream - Crown (all three roles), Chimaerus (healer, tank) and Vanguard (tank) - and three more are short (Vaelgor & Ezzorak DPS 26/27 and tank 5/6, Vanguard DPS 26/27); per the standing "empty = nothing to ingest" rule the 59 stored rows those cuts do not reproduce were LEFT UNTOUCHED rather than erased. File still holds 677 tier rows (floor 440) and keeps Archon's own cut date 2026-08-14, never the run date, because no row moved. The committed encounter `name` values were not rewritten.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages (metric "survivability" specifically, the third of Archon's three raid tierLists): 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, ZERO tiers moved for the third run running. spec.survivability keeps its stored asOf 2026-08-14 because nothing moved. Same caveat as the throughput list: the Season-1 raid sample behind these tiers is only 4277/1120/600 parses on a pool that is now dead content, so quiet here is not the same as settled.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList, which carries letters only) on the raid DPS + raid tank pages = 33 rows, each with n = that spec's parse count. Every value AND every parse count is byte-identical to stored (floats rounded to match the stored integer precision, e.g. Devourer 167319.898 -> 167320, n 602). PARTIAL, and the reason matters: Archon's own cut label DID move to 2026-08-15T12:00:00Z tonight, so a label-following merge would have re-dated 160 unchanged numbers as fresh. That is the bloodmallet/wowmeta asOf failure mode exactly - a source whose label ticks daily can never trip a staleness gate - so nothing was merged and the family's coverage date stays 2026-08-14 (1 day old, threshold 5). The raid healer page also exposes a dps column (healer DPS); it is excluded here exactly as the stored 33-row shape has always excluded it.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection.table.data[] (hps column, n = parses): 7/7 healer specs, 0 unmatched, every value and parse count byte-identical to stored. Same disposition and same reason as archon-metrics - Archon re-stamped its cut label to 2026-08-15 without any of the numbers moving, so nothing was merged and the stored date stays 2026-08-14 (1 day, threshold 5). Reported as its own row rather than folded into archon-metrics so a failure of one series can never hide behind the other.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ aggregate pages' specRankingsSection.table.data[] (score column, n = parses): 40/40 specs, 0 unmatched, every value and parse count byte-identical to stored - e.g. Devourer 4196 at n=169085, unchanged since the 08-10 cut. Archon's M+ numbers are genuinely frozen: Season 1 keys are dead content since 12.1 shipped on 08-11, so the population feeding the 95th percentile has stopped growing. Nothing merged; stored coverage date stays 2026-08-10, which is 5 days against a threshold of 5 - i.e. this row goes red on the heartbeat tomorrow unless Archon re-aggregates, and that red is the correct signal rather than something to paper over by adopting tonight's re-stamped label.

"Popularity" re-read from specRankingsSection.table.data[] across all six aggregate pages = 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched. Shape-checked before any merge would have been considered: every value is a plausible percentage, the six (role x bracket) groups sum to 99.9-100.1 and the whole set to 600.0, and no row equals that spec's "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" - the 2026-07 failure where DPS magnitudes shipped under unit %. All 80 values are byte-identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision. Nothing merged. The coverage date is the 60th-freshest of 80 rows = 2026-08-10 (the raid half stands at 08-14, the M+ half at 08-10), 5 days against a threshold of 5, for the same frozen-upstream reason as the M+ score row.

Both JSON API calls fetched fresh with plain curl, no headers, no proxy, never the HTML page: manifest.json gives snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json returns 44 blocks, of which the whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined selects 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee/ranged are subsets of dps and are excluded, not merely "not dungeon"). classSpec names matched the roster 40/40 with no mapping table. The rankings file was DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest date, per the 08-04 lesson that the two steps run independently: all 40 lowerBound values are byte-identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision, and the file's own Last-Modified header reads Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT, so upstream really has not re-snapshotted. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's 2026-08-11 (4 days, threshold 8), never today.

No WCL credentials in this run by design; the only input is the pre-agent wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-15T19:52:26Z), whose verdict is "rdps-broken": characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error" while OAuth and GraphQL transport are both healthy (3600 points/hour, 1 spent). The evidence lands no rows for this key, so the zone-46 Mythic rDPS/HPS medians could not honestly be refreshed and the 47 stored rows are untouched at 2026-08-10. Nothing was fetched from warcraftlogs.com by this agent, by any means.

Same single input and same verdict as wcl-live-raid: wcl-fetch/evidence.json reports "rdps-broken" (rdps@3176 -> Internal server error, httpStatus 200, 0 rankings) and lands no rows for this key. The 40 stored zone-47 M+ median rows stay unchanged at 2026-08-10. Note the standing distinction: "rdps-broken" is a statement about the v2 GraphQL API, and the separately-dead HTML statistics transport (Cloudflare human-challenge since 2026-08-10) is a different fact - neither is a licence to substitute dps-family numbers under an rDPS-labelled series.

Evidence verdict "rdps-broken", no rows landed for this key, so the 34 stored "12.1 PTR raid testing score (normalized)" rows stay at 2026-07-28. Two independent reasons this cut cannot come back on our side: the zone-54 normalized score has no GraphQL analogue at all (it is a cross-boss normalized 0-100 that only the HTML statistics table publishes), and 12.1 shipped on 08-11 so PTR raid testing is over. maxAgeDays is 40 for exactly this window; at 18 days the row is inside it.

Evidence verdict "rdps-broken" and no rows landed for this key, so the 40 stored "Median rDPS/HPS (12.1 PTR M+ testing)" rows stay unchanged at 2026-08-10. The zone-56 raw-DPS sibling (wcl-ptr-mplus-raw) DID land tonight from the same evidence file, which is the standing reminder that the two series ride different recipes and that a healthy raw fetch is never evidence the rdps family is fixed.

spec.ptrDummy holds median rDPS by target count and therefore depends on the same broken rdps metric family; the evidence file lands no rows for this key, so all 27 stored ptrDummy records stay at 2026-08-10 and the build's Dummy Dome composite is computed from unchanged data. The zone-52 RAW-DPS medians are a different statistic and did land (see wcl-dummy-raw) - raw DPS is never dressed up as rDPS.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-dummy-raw"] alone: 102 rows built and 102 applied by the deterministic pre-agent step, with all four DPS dummies ok - 1T 2000 ranked players, 2T 662, 3T 297, 5T 2000 (complete pagination per the frozen recipe, since rankings are best-parse-per-player sorted best-first and a partial median would be biased high). 103 of the 106 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Dummy Dome, NT)" rows now carry asOf 2026-08-15; the three that do not (07-30, 08-07, 08-10) are specs absent from tonight's leaderboards. The agent did not re-fetch, recompute or edit any of these rows. previousAsOf is already 2026-08-15 because an earlier run of this same UTC day landed the series; the values did move again tonight.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-raid-raw"]: 27 rows built and 27 applied across the zone-54 Heroic boss pool, all eight encounters ok - Nek'zali 370 players, Entombed Sentinels 363, Vashnik 678, The Lost Explorers 150, Sszorak 184, The Twin Fangs 146, and The Coiled Altar and Ula'tek at 0 (unlogged, which is an empty encounter rather than an error). All 27 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR Venomous Abyss ...)" rows carry asOf 2026-08-15. Written from the evidence file only; the agent performed no WCL fetch.

Claimed from evidence.landed["wcl-ptr-mplus-raw"]: 27 rows built and 27 applied across all eight zone-56 dungeons, each returning the 2000-player pagination ceiling (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena). All 27 stored "Median raw DPS (12.1 PTR M+ keys ...)" rows carry asOf 2026-08-15. Written from the evidence file only; the agent performed no WCL fetch.

All three meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 40-71 KB, and parsed to 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40/40 specs with 0 unmatched. Every "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" value reproduces the stored number exactly (e.g. Guardian Druid 4268, Brewmaster 4038, Blood DK 3990), so nothing needed merging. The pages still label themselves "Midnight Season 1" while their body text says "Patch 12.1", and they state an 8-hourly refresh with "Updated 3-4 hours ago" - the numbers are the source's own current cut, they simply have not moved. Stored asOf was already 2026-08-15 from an earlier run of this UTC day, so no date could advance; the claim rests on the live re-read. The number stays labelled a top-50 CEILING, never popularity.

All 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each (the 76-byte error body is transient, not structural). 14 charts returned data and 13 returned "No standard chart with these" after 3 tries - Augmentation Evoker is the known by-design absence, the other 12 are simply not re-simmed yet. EVERY one of the 14 carries simc_settings.tier MID2 and a chart timestamp of 2026-08-15, against a stored pool that is entirely MID1 at 2026-07-08. That is the mixed-tier case the 2026-08-15 gate exists for, so NOTHING was merged: fightLabels pools every DPS profile into one flat array with no provenance key and derives the ST/cleave/AoE labels as within-role percentiles over it, MID2 runs ~1.79x MID1 (measured), and merging 14 of 27 would publish "which specs have been re-simmed" as spec strength. Adopt wholesale or not at all - and note that a wholesale adoption will need a human value_move_ack, since the MID2 values are 1.5-2.5x the stored ones. asOf stays the CHART's own date, so the family sits 38 days stale and the heartbeat red is the true signal that this is upstream's roll-over, not our fetch.

Both transports checked. MID1_Raid.txt is currently a live in-progress log (272 bytes, no "DPS Ranking:" block) whose header reads "12.1.0.69299 Live (hotfix 2026-08-15/69299, git build HEAD b642585cbf)" - a Season-2 re-sim is running right now. MID1_Raid.html therefore remains the parseable report, and it is unchanged: SimulationCraft 1205-01 for WoW 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06/68974), git build 678e66d384, Timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33+0000 - the same build hash and timestamp the stored 26 rows came from. Era-verified off that header build string, not the visible "12.3.0" (which is the Highcharts version). An unchanged hash is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse, so nothing was merged and asOf stays 2026-08-08 (7 days, threshold 10). Expect the values to move sharply once the 69299 run publishes a ranking block.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), HTTP 200, 184 KB, resolving to period 1075 MID1 (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar, Tyrannical, Fortified, Xal'atath's Guile) - no half-landed weekly roll. The parse was bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and stopped at the next heading, which is what keeps it at 34 rows rather than the 59 a whole-page scan returns from the "Classes and specs" and per-dungeon blocks. Labels normalised on [-\s]+ both sides; 34 matched, 0 unmatched (the 6 absent specs have no representation this period). Column identity confirmed by sum: 100.3 total with role subtotals DPS 60.2 / tank 20.0 / healer 20.1, i.e. the representation SHARE series and not the /meta per-key-presence figure. All 34 values are byte-identical to stored, so period 1075 is the same cut we already hold; nothing merged, asOf stays 2026-08-14 (1 day, threshold 5).

Four channels swept, nothing new to log. (1) Official dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl (full post_stream, not WebFetch): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09Z, newest is Linxy #19 - already the feed's 07-31 entry. The PTR thread has been quiet for 15 days because the PTR cycle ended when 12.1 shipped on 08-11. (2) Wowhead news RSS: 40 items parsed per <item> block, newest 2026-08-15 12:40 CDT; the only class-tuning item is "Season 2 Class Tuning Incoming with Weekly Reset - Blood DK Nerf" (news 382466), which IS the feed's newest entry, logged earlier today from Linxy's standalone topic 2336820. (3) Wowhead news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) polled as well since it leads RSS: 20 posts, top id 382472, nothing beyond RSS. (4) Blue-tracker payload (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, deduped by topic; the only blues since the last logged build are the Aug-14 Kaivax hotfixes and the Aug-12 "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans" roadmap. Both were read in full and neither is feed material: the Aug 13 and Aug 14 hotfix posts contain a Classes section that is entirely BUG FIXES (Devastation Shattering Star / Mastery, Warrior Executioner double-effect, Warlock pet Soul Leech, Demonology cooldown-manager, Affliction Seed of Corruption) with no tuning values, and the roadmap is a schedule of future dates (Aug 18, Aug 25, Sep 1, Sep 22) with no per-spec lines. Writing either as "Spec Class - ..." highlights would put bug-fix and calendar text into the outlook tally. Writeup coverage recomputed rather than read: exactly one spec has no ptr writeup (Demonology Warlock, whose null is the deliberate "the source reported no changes" case), and every spec now carries both a raid-scoped and an M+-scoped expert read.

Discovery ran clean and distillation could not: transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "limit-exceeded" with requested 1 / fetched 0 (bqVHzvKJCuA), i.e. the Supadata free-tier monthly budget is exhausted, so zero transcripts existed to distil and no take or metaNote was added. This agent fetched no transcript from YouTube or any API. RSS discovery: all 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff, 44/44 succeeded, 660 entries scanned against a 1035-id seen-set built from the four structured lanes (seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] plus every youtu.be id in creator-takes.json) - never by regex over log prose. 25 videos were unseen. SIX were queued, all keyword-in-scope per the nightly rule: shGSOb8YoMQ (YoDaTV, 12.1 M+ tier list update), oomrLdyB8YA (Jedith, Devourer tuning), DMtMmUW5uRE (LBNinja7, healer tuning), c_5u7Jpy-Uo (AutomaticJak, healer tuning + tier list update), lanOZvwWzw0 (Musguete, Assassination tuning) and OdhbpI6Mjsw (izen, final Season-2 buffs/nerfs - the metaNotes lane, since izen is a generalCreator and is firewalled out of takes[]). THREE were retired to seen[] as durable dismissals on an explicit PvP frame, which is permanently out of scope for this PvE tracker: wzynLjlZJf4 and Fi5pYpANSQ0 (Supatease PvP) and oUjUd8kcWew (Dalaran Gaming, "5v5 1v1 Duels - PvP"). The remaining 16 were deliberately left UNSEEN rather than marked off - guides and routes (Tactyks, Dalaran, Megasett, Baze, Sha), stream VODs and Shorts (Tettles x2, AutomaticJak, Kalamazi, Critcake, NeekapHere), Maximum's live "AWTF test stream", Harrek's raw Dummy Dome pull footage and two untitled-PvP-lens Supatease uploads - because a budget or title dismissal is not durable and must stay reconsiderable by a local run. bqVHzvKJCuA remains queued and remains the suspected still-live stream flagged on 08-09; yt-dlp could not settle it from this runner (the datacenter bot wall, as expected), so it was left in place rather than purged on a guess.
